bodies.name: a refusal with the server error
a reason the server does not know yet
a reason that is not a token
an error name with a space (a message)
an error code with a path
a browser not in the list
a device memory not of the six
a storage bucket not of the five
a web flag that is not a bool
a device model with a space (a name)

queue.name: a burst is one report with its count
after it was accepted, the same day makes no report
the next day: a new report, not the first
no answer keeps it, and the count goes on
at most 32 in the queue, the oldest go first
two days queued: only the first is the first report
flags.issues false drops the queue and records nothing
a plain network failure that reached nothing is not reported
the app misusing the API is not reported
a status is part of the signature
